personality_one_liner: A clean, highly legible financial command center wrapped in the warmth of traditional saffron and gold festive tones.

spacing.rule: Use generous vertical breathing room. Pad cards aggressively (lg to xl) and avoid tight data density unless in a dedicated transaction list.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar.
Use glass on sticky headers over scrollable feeds (like Vargani and Expenses lists).
Use frosted glass overlay on the Hero KPI card sitting on the festive background.
dont's: Do not use glass on regular list rows or input fields.
Do not use glass if the background has no texture or image.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A commanding financial overview showing targets, collections, and quick actions.

states.empty: Not applicable for dashboard; default to 0 metrics
states.error: Error fetching dashboard data + Retry button

screens.layout: Hero balance card at the top utilizing a festive backdrop with glassmorphism overlay containing 'Total Target', 'Collected', and 'Pending' figures in monospaced font. Followed by a 2x2 grid of quick actions (Add Vargani, Add Expense). Scrollable recent activity feed threaded below.

screens.name: Members
screens.purpose: Directory of all Mandal members and approval workflow for Admins.

states.empty: Illustration of Lord Ganesha + 'No members found'
states.error: Failed to load members + Retry button

screens.layout: Top tabbed navigation (Pending, Approved). List view with padded cards showing member avatar, name, and role/status badge. Pending tab includes prominent Approve (Success color) and Reject (Error color) actions.

screens.name: Vargani
screens.purpose: Detailed ledger of community donations with search and filtering.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + 'No contributions recorded yet'
states.error: Failed to load Vargani + Retry button

screens.layout: Search bar and sticky filter chips (All, Advance, Pending) below header. Chronological feed of transactions with color-coded amounts (Green for collected, Yellow for pending). Tapping a row opens a bottom sheet with details.

screens.name: Expenses
screens.purpose: Track outbound funds categorized by festival needs.

states.error: Failed to load expenses + Retry button

screens.layout: Top summary card of 'Total Spent'. Categorized list below. Sticky primary CTA 'Add Expense' at the bottom right (FAB) or bottom centered.

screens.name: Events
screens.purpose: Schedule of festival events and completion statuses.

states.error: Failed to load events + Retry button

screens.layout: Vertical list of event cards. Each card has a date badge on the left, event title, location, and status (Upcoming/Completed) on the right.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Saffron/Gold palette defined in the guidelines, avoiding generic blue/purple finance patterns.
Implement the Dashboard Hero card using the provided 'hero_background' image covered by an expo-linear-gradient scrim and expo-glass-effect (or expo-blur) so text remains readable.
Use 'Space Grotesk' for all financial figures and metrics to ensure alignment and scannability, utilizing 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for standard body text.
The Members screen must implement a tabbed interface (Pending vs Approved) for Admin roles. Pending cards should highlight quick Approve/Reject actions.
Ensure 'Add Vargani' and 'Add Expense' are highly accessible, either through the Dashboard quick action 2x2 grid or sticky CTAs at the bottom of their respective screens.
Lists (Vargani, Expenses) should use clear color coding: Success Green for collected/positive, Warning Yellow for pending, and Error Red for outgoing/cancelled.
